correctness.rationale: Hub excursions in F_m have mean three and petal completion probabilities 1/2 from untouched and 3/4 from half-covered. Poisson splitting into m independent rate-1/m petal streams gives survival 2exp(-3u/4)-exp(-u) and the exact integral; Wald plus the last return correction -2 converts excursion count to discrete edge steps. Star excursions give 4mH_(2m)-1. Comparison with a shifted exponential maximum, x=y/m and a dominated-convergence bound yields positive deficit coefficient 2^{2/3} Gamma(4/3) m^{2/3}; algebra of the harmonic correction is lower order. Independently solved exact rational two-state petal recursion for m=1..5, finding 3,89/7,18981/770,571073/15015 and 67881771/1293292, and computed the coefficient 1.4175166160510755. Infinite limit rests on analytic dominance, not finite simulation.
